result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by limiting exclusivity to Deerskin Products for 12 months and providing automatic termination if HDI misses service levels or delivery dates. It preserves the agreement’s term and the core brand/site arrangement. However, extending the fall-away trigger to failure of any “other performance obligations” goes beyond the required fallback and could terminate exclusivity for an unrelated or minor breach. The retained phrase “exclusive right to use of” is also grammatically awkward.
